blocks.raw: # Subscription program
blocks.text: Subscription program

blocks.raw: This section provides you with information about subscription program and how to set up a subscription program.
blocks.text: This section provides you with information about subscription program and how to set up a subscription program.

blocks.raw: Subscription programs (previously called supplementary programs ) are small and segmented loyalty programs that run along with loyalty programs but for a shorter span. An org can create any number of subscription programs. These can be paid or unpaid programs. These programs have incentives or benefits over and above the basic loyalty program to incentivize more loyal customers better.

blocks.raw: Benefits of Subscription Loyalty:
blocks.text: Benefits of Subscription Loyalty:

blocks.raw:
* Personalized and segmented incentives from Day 1
* Extra revenue generated by the brand due to the subscription fee
* Always-on offers for the customers
* Rewards drive conversion and engagement
* Accurate attribution to programs increased AOV and retention

blocks.raw: Some of the salient features of the subscription program are:
blocks.text: Some of the salient features of the subscription program are:

blocks.raw:
* Micro-segmented/Personalized programs
* Paid & unpaid loyalty subscriptions
* Event-based: Through various events like registration, transaction, etc or via APIs
* No partner, hence no tier sync
* Has limited validity varying between 3 to 12 months
* Brands can setup expiry based on their contracts

blocks.raw:
4. In the **Name** field, enter the program's name without blank spaces.
5. In the **Description** box, enter a brief description of the program.
6. In the **Duration** field, enter the program's validity in days or months. This is the period during which a customer remains enrolled in a subscription program and can enjoy its benefits. When a customer is linked to a subscription program, the exact day they enroll is treated as a bonus "Day 0." The official count for the configured duration starts at midnight. For example, if you set the duration to **5 Days** and a customer enrolls on **April 1st at 10:00 AM**, the system will add exactly 5 full days to their enrollment date, and the day the customer enrolls is considered as day zero. The subscription will remain active from 10 AM on April 1st and will officially expire on **April 6th at 11:59:59 PM (End of Day)**.
7. Click **Next**.

blocks.raw: ## Subscription program expiry and downgrade loyalty tier
blocks.text: Subscription program expiry and downgrade loyalty tier

blocks.raw: In the **Settings** section, you can set the subscription program expiry and configure the loyalty tier downgrade setting.
blocks.text: In the Settings section, you can set the subscription program expiry and configure the loyalty tier downgrade setting.

blocks.raw: ### Set subscription program expiry
blocks.text: Set subscription program expiry

blocks.raw: To set up the subscription program expiry,
blocks.text: To set up the subscription program expiry,

blocks.raw:
1. In the **Set subscription program expiry**, select **Yes**.
2. In the **Valid till** field, set the expiry date for the subscription program.
3. In the **Migrate customers on program expiry** turn on the toggle switch and from the **Transfer to** drop-down select the subscription program to migrate the customers to a different subscription program after the expiry of the present subscription program.
4. Click **Save**.

blocks.raw: ### Configure loyalty tier downgrade
blocks.text: Configure loyalty tier downgrade

blocks.raw: When a customer unsubscribes or delinks from a program, you can set it to downgrade their loyalty tier automatically.
blocks.text: When a customer unsubscribes or delinks from a program, you can set it to downgrade their loyalty tier automatically.

blocks.raw: To set, in the **Set loyalty tier on downgrade**, select **Yes** and from the **Downgrade to loyalty tier** drop-down, select the tier to which the customer should be downgraded, and click **Save**.

blocks.raw: ## Set expiry reminder
blocks.text: Set expiry reminder

blocks.raw: To set the expiry reminder, in the **Expiry reminder**, enter the days before which the reminder should be sent and click **Save**. You can click **+Reminder** and configure multiple reminders. You can customize the SMS, e-mail, and push notifications for sending reminders.
